we can initialise l_calloutInvPath with i_callouts[0], instead of updating here
no that will not work, in case "getInventoryObjPathFromJson" returns an empty string, it will overwrite l_calloutInvPath
Acknowledged
Do we need `l_userData1` and `l_userData2` variables? These can be used inplace in the map construction?
Acknowledged
This can be `const`
Acknowledged
`i_invalidRecordList` can contain records for which `EccException` or `DataException` was encountered, so should we create PEL with type `EccCheckFailed` only?

Agree, but there is no entry in message registry which states that it can be both kind of error.
The one that was being logged before was only addressing data issue. So going with the high probability one. Going forward, we Will have to eventually add a new entry in message registry JSON and fix this.
Acknowledged
not throwing exception instead catching and logging in the API ?
